# Halo Mega Bloks (Project Haggar) decompilation

> Decompilation and native PC port of Project Haggar, the cancelled Halo Mega Bloks game (n-Space, Xbox 360, Unreal Engine 3). Also spelled "Halo Mega Blocks". n-Space built it on the UDK July 2012 BETA 2 engine until 343 Industries cancelled it in 2013. The project rebuilds a development build from source: a static recompilation of the whole Xbox 360 executable for a native port (PC first, then an Anbernic handheld), a byte-matching decompilation of n-Space's own C++, and the game's UnrealScript. Source only, released under CC0 1.0; no game files or SDK files are included, and users supply their own copy of the build.

## Goal

A proper decomp of the game's own code and scripts: n-Space's native C++ (1,417 functions, 149,468 bytes) matched byte for byte, the UnrealScript compiling with UDK's compiler, and documented data formats and extraction tools. It is the foundation for reading and modding the game, playing it natively (PC, later an Anbernic handheld), and eventually finishing it: a rebuild as a UDK July 2012 BETA 2 project (Phase 5), and possibly a remake in a modern Unreal Engine by others. The engine, middleware and Epic's UDKBase/GameFramework code are recompiled by the port, not decompiled. No assets are shipped; everyone uses their own copy. Scope checks done: Grip is Autodesk Gameware's middleware (out of scope); n-Space's 159 additions to Epic's classes are in scope.

## Key facts

- Game: Project Haggar, the Halo Mega Bloks game by n-Space for the Xbox 360, cancelled in 2013. Engine: Unreal Engine 3, exactly UDK July 2012 BETA 2 (engine version 10246, changelist 1340247).
- Inputs: a development build with a full private PDB (237,168 functions, 759,808 type records). The executable is a devkit-signed XEX2.
- Matching compiler: XDK 21076, cl 16.00.11886 for PowerPC, with each object's command line from the PDB. 1,417 n-Space functions (149,468 bytes) in scope, 1,237 of them matched (121,312 bytes), 8 near and 172 todo.
- Port: the recompiled build runs natively on Windows x86-64 from boot to the first level (ReXGlue SDK codegen and its Xenia-derived runtime; 237,162 functions, no unimplemented instruction), and builds on Linux. Next: Linux on real GPUs, then a native renderer for handhelds.
- Scripts: 758 UnrealScript classes (n-Space's own and those modified from UDK) are in script/, with every decompiler error fixed; tools/udk_compile.py checks them with UDK's compiler.
- Data: docs/FORMATS.md documents the package and map formats; tools/map_export.py exports actor placements from your own copy.
- Playable natively on Windows to the first level, with the build's own known issues.
